personality: 7 Dark-First Utility layout + 6 Glass/Luxe premium surfaces
personality_one_liner: A command-center for fitness that feels heavy, athletic, and precise, combining dark graphite utility with premium frosted glass and voltage-ember accents.

spacing.rule: Generous container padding with tighter internal grouping for metric density. Thumb-zone adherence for all active tracking session buttons.

do's: Apply dark frosted glass on sticky bottom tab bar
Apply heavy tinted glass overlay on the Hero Workout cards over imagery
Use glass on modal scrims and sticky headers during active scrolling
dont's: Never blur dense tracking form fields or standard list rows

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Glanceable high-density summary of today's fitness data

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping to the bento-layout
states.empty: Prompt to 'Start your first workout' or 'Log today's meals'

screens.layout: Hero 'Today's Workout' card at top with dark photo background, gradient scrim, and glass text container. Below: Bento-grid of stat cards (BMI, weight trend, total calories). A 'Macro Ring Trio' showing Protein (Ember), Carbs (Green), Fat (Yellow) completion. Weekly consistency streak dots.

screens.name: Workout
screens.purpose: Command center for discovering plans and active session logging

states.empty: No active plans - display library categories
states.error: Failed to load workout database, Retry button

screens.layout: Library tab: muscle group tiles and plan categories (full-body, PPL). Active Session tab: persistent sticky bottom CTA ('Finish Session'). Heavy condensed numerals for timer/reps. Plate-weight stepper with haptics. Rest timer overlay with a depleting progress ring.

screens.name: Nutrition
screens.purpose: Chronological food diary and macro progress tracking

states.empty: Illustration of meal prep containers + 'Log your first meal'

screens.layout: Top section: large horizontal macro progress bars. Middle: chronological meal timeline (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks) using card-based grouped list. FAB for 'Quick Log' / full-screen barcode scanner. Water tracking horizontal stepper at the bottom.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Analytics visualization and gamified milestone tracking
screens.layout: Interactive analytics charts (weight history, volume over time) with horizontal date selector pills. Muscle heat map. Below: Gamification shelf showing XP, current Level badge, achievements, and PR list in highly contrasted secondary cards.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Settings, account goals, and preferences management
screens.layout: Top cover banner with abstract gym image and profile avatar. Single-column list rows with Phosphor icons mapped in brandTertiary tinted boxes. Goal settings, equipment profile selection, language toggle (DE/EN/ES/FR/IT), and Admin entry point.

workout_library_hero.alt: Woman surrounded by heavy exercise equipment

nutrition_empty_state.alt: Healthy macro meal prep in glass containers

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the 'Charcoal and Voltage' aesthetic. Base backgrounds are deep graphite/slate, not pure black (#000), to prevent eye strain.
No blue or purple allowed. Stick rigidly to the defined palette: Ember (FF3D00) as primary, with Success/Warning variants mapped to Carbs/Fat.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for heavy metrics (Timer digits, Weight amounts, Rep counts) combined with 'Satoshi' for readable body text and standard UI elements.
Implement the 'Macro Ring Trio' on the dashboard and prominent horizontal bars in Nutrition. Reanimated must be used for smooth visual filling of these progress rings upon mount.
Live workout session tracking requires a sticky bottom 'Finish Session' CTA button attached to the screen root, not inside scrolling content.
Every image used as a hero or backdrop MUST feature the vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse).
List rows for profile settings and categories should default to using Phosphor icons housed in a 'brandTertiary' tinted box, rather than naked icons.
